name: Build Respec
description: Coordinates a full or partial rebuild across skill ranks and attribute allocations. It asks each owner for a pure respec plan, calculates the optional currency price, and spends through economy.currency's synchronous spend function. It then emits one transaction request with expected refunds; the skill tree and attribute sheet perform their own resets and acknowledge the same transaction id. Completed means every expected owner acknowledged exactly once, never that this component reached into either database. Duplicate requests or acknowledgements cannot refund twice, and insufficient funds reject before any build mutation.

inputs.name: baseCost
inputs.description: Flat currency cost for a confirmed respec. Zero keeps experimentation free.

inputs.name: costPerRefundedPoint
inputs.description: Additional currency price per combined skill and attribute point in the plan.

inputs.name: refundFraction
inputs.description: Fraction of invested skill and attribute points returned, from 0 to 1. The price and the refund are separate decisions.

inputs.name: allowPartial
inputs.description: Whether selected-node or selected-attribute respecs are allowed in addition to full scopes.

inputs.name: partialPolicy
inputs.description: Reject a partial skill plan that would orphan dependents, or include every dependent explicitly in the confirmation plan.

inputs.name: requireConfirmation
inputs.description: Whether input.respecBuild must confirm the exact plan hash and price before payment or mutation.

outputs.name: lastPlan
outputs.description: The dependency-safe skill and attribute changes, separate refunds, price, scope, and stable plan hash shown for confirmation.

outputs.name: pendingTransaction
outputs.description: Transaction id and expected owner acknowledgements, or null when none is pending.

outputs.name: lastRefund
outputs.description: Actual skillPoints and attributePoints returned by the completed transaction.

provenance: RPG buildcraft pass on 2026-11-02 searched Upgrade Tree, Prestige Reset, Skills Tree, Attribute Sheet, Currency and Run Meta Progression. Upgrade Tree only sells its own incremental nodes, Prestige Reset starts a meta progression cycle, and the other owners hold build or currency state without coordinating a rebuild. No contract owned priced, dependency-safe, cross-system respec transactions, so this orchestrates plans and acknowledgements while leaving each owner's state in place.
